## **Initialization**

Load R packages, custom functions, and data needed for the analysis.

<br>

```{r load_libraries}

#use BiocManager::install("package_name") or install.package("package_name") to install packages

# Load Libraries

library(htmltools) # html tools for report visualization
library(reactable) # nice table visualization
library(stringr)

library(RColorBrewer) # nice color scale
library(pheatmap) # nice heatmap

# libraries from BiocManager

library(biomaRt) # search for gene names

```

## **Pre-processing:**

Preparation of the data for analysis with EdgeR-limma-voom pipeline. For more details 

<br>

``` {r pre-processing}

samples = colnames(raw_counts.df)

parts = strsplit(samples, "\\.")

batch = sapply(parts, `[`, 1)

replicate = sapply(parts, `[`, 2)

phenotype = sapply(parts, function(x)
    paste(x[3:(length(x)-1)], collapse = "."))

treatment = sapply(parts, function(x) tail(x, 1))

batch.rep = paste(batch, replicate, sep = ".")

group = paste(phenotype, treatment, sep = ".")

phenotype.ord = c("M0","M2","M0.M1","M2.M1")

group.ord = c("M0.Veh","M0.PM",
              "M2.Veh","M2.PM",
              "M0.M1.Veh","M0.M1.PM",
              "M2.M1.Veh","M2.M1.PM")
# Create design table for merged data
design.df = data.frame(sampleID = samples,
                       Batch = factor(batch, levels = unique(batch)),
                       Phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels= phenotype.ord),
                       Treatment = factor(treatment,
                                          levels = unique(treatment)),
                       Replicate = factor(replicate,
                                          levels = unique(replicate)),
                       Batch.Rep = factor(batch.rep, levels = unique(batch.rep)),
                       Group = factor(group,
                                      levels = group.ord))

# define colors of the clusters
sample.annot.color = c("#DDB667","#FD9F38","#F09A93","#B2172B",
                       "#A6CEE3","#599DC8","#A8D08D","#3A924A")
names(sample.annot.color)=group.ord

# Convert ensembl id to gene names
rownames(raw_counts.df) = get_human_gene_names(rownames(raw_counts.df), 
                                            mirror = "www",
                                            path = mart_path)

# Creating a DGEList object 
dge = DGEList(counts=raw_counts.df)

#remove genes with very low counts across all samples. This value can be changed based on results of the density plot in the QC but this is the common standard
message("Genes before filtering: ", nrow(dge))
keep = filterByExpr(dge, group = design.df$Group)

dge = dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
message("Genes after filtering : ", nrow(dge))

# Normalize count for DE analysis (trimmed mean of M-values)
dge = calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")

#save dds object
saveRDS(dge, file = paste0(path,analyzed_data_folder,"dge_edgeR.rds"))

# Normalize data for sample distances and PCA plots
# log2CPM
logCPM = cpm(dge, log = TRUE)

```

<br>

## **Quality Control:** {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

<br>

Control of data quality is performed by checking that library sizes are similar, especially after normalization, and that most of the genes with low counts across all samples have been properly removed. 
Sample distances and Principal Component Analysis (PCA)) on vst-normalized data can be used to visualize similarity between samples and verify the presence of batch effect that might hinder biological differences in the analysis. 

<br>

### Histogram plot of library sizes before normalization

``` {r QC_Histogram, fig.width=30, fig.height=6}

# Check for read count across sample
total.count = data.frame(Count  = colSums(dge$counts),
                         Sample = colnames(dge$counts),
                         Group  = group)

# reorder Sample column following order established in boxplot section
total.count$Sample = factor(total.count$Sample, 
                            levels = colnames(dge$counts))

# boxplot
ggplot(total.count, aes(x = Sample, y = Count, fill = Group))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  ylab(label = "Total read count") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma,expand = c(0,0)) +
  plot_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=50, hjust=1))+
  ggtitle("Library size")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=sample.annot.color)
  
```

### Boxplot of raw and normalized counts

``` {r QC_Boxplot, fig.width=10, fig.height=30}

# Prepare raw counts
pseudo.raw = log2(dge$counts + 1)
df.raw = reshape2::melt(pseudo.raw)
df.raw$Group = rep(group, each = nrow(dge))
df.raw$Var2 = factor(df.raw$Var2, levels = colnames(dge$counts))
df.raw$Type = "Raw counts"

# Prepare normalized counts
pseudo.norm = log2(cpm(dge) + 1)
df.norm = reshape2::melt(pseudo.norm)
df.norm$Group = rep(group, each = nrow(dge))
df.norm$Var2 = factor(df.raw$Var2, levels = colnames(dge$counts))
df.norm$Type = "Normalized counts"

# Combine and set order
plot.dt = rbind(df.raw, df.norm)

plot.dt$Type = factor(plot.dt$Type,
                      levels = c("Raw counts", "Normalized counts"))

# Plot 
ggplot(plot.dt, aes(x = Var2, y = value, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~Type, ncol = 2) +
  ggtitle("Boxplot of Raw and Normalized Counts") +
  xlab("Sample") +
  ylab("log2(count + 1)") +
  plot_theme +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 14))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample.annot.color)

```

### Density plot of raw and normalized counts

``` {r QC_Density, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}

#add a small value to have a good separation between peak of genes with 0 counts and those intermediate or high expression
epsilon = 0.00001 

# Unfiltered raw counts
pseudo.unfilt = log2(raw_counts.df + epsilon)
df.unfilt = reshape2::melt(as.matrix(pseudo.unfilt))
df.unfilt$Group = design.df$Group[match(df.unfilt$Var2,
                                         design.df$sampleID)]
df.unfilt$Sample = df.unfilt$Var2
df.unfilt$Type = "Raw counts\n(before filtering)"

# Raw counts
pseudo.raw = log2(dge$counts + epsilon)
df.raw = reshape2::melt(pseudo.raw)
df.raw$Group = rep(group, each = nrow(dge))
df.raw$Sample = df.raw$Var2
df.raw$Type = "Raw counts"

# Normalized counts
pseudo.norm = log2(cpm(dge) + epsilon)
df.norm = reshape2::melt(pseudo.norm)
df.norm$Group = rep(group, each = nrow(dge))
df.norm$Sample = df.norm$Var2
df.norm$Type = "Normalized \ncounts"

# Combine and enforce order
plot.dt = rbind(df.unfilt, df.raw, df.norm)

plot.dt$Type = factor(plot.dt$Type,
                      levels = c("Raw counts\n(before filtering)",
                                 "Raw counts",
                                 "Normalized \ncounts"))

# Plot
ggplot(plot.dt, aes(x = value, group = Sample, color = Group)) +
  geom_density() +
  facet_wrap(~Type, ncol = 3) +
  ggtitle("Density plots of gene counts") +
  xlab("log2(count)") +
  plot_theme +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, NA)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sample.annot.color) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 14))

```

### Sample distances {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

#### Without batch effect correction

``` {r sample_distances, fig.width=30, fig.height=30}

# Compute distance between sample and cluster sample in a heatmap
sample.dist = dist(t(logCPM),
                    method = "euclidean")
sample.dist.mat = as.matrix(sample.dist)
# create df for row and column names of the heatmap
df = as.data.frame(group)
rownames(df) = rownames(dge$samples)
colnames(df) = "Group"

#plot sample distances
pheatmap(sample.dist.mat,
         clustering_distance_rows = sample.dist,
         clustering_distance_cols = sample.dist,
         color=colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9, "Blues")))(255),
         annotation_col = df,
         annotation_colors = list(Group=sample.annot.color),
         fontsize = 14,
         main = "Sample distances without batch effect correction")

```

#### With batch effect correction

``` {r sample_distances_batch, fig.width=30, fig.height=30}

design = model.matrix(~ group)

logCPM.corrected = removeBatchEffect(logCPM,
    batch = batch,
    batch2 = replicate,
    design = design)

# Compute distance between sample and cluster sample in a heatmap
sample.dist = dist(t(logCPM.corrected),
                    method = "euclidean")
sample.dist.mat = as.matrix(sample.dist)
# create df for row and column names of the heatmap
df = as.data.frame(group)
rownames(df) = rownames(dge$samples)
colnames(df) = "Group"

#plot sample distances
pheatmap(sample.dist.mat,
         clustering_distance_rows = sample.dist,
         clustering_distance_cols = sample.dist,
         color=colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9, "Blues")))(255),
         annotation_col = df,
         annotation_colors = list(Group=sample.annot.color),
         fontsize = 14,
         main = "Sample distances with batch effect correction")

```

``` {r mds}

mds = plotMDS(logCPM, plot = FALSE)
df_mds = tibble(Sample = design.df$sampleID,
                MDS1 = mds$x,
                MDS2 = mds$y,
                Replicate = design.df$Replicate,
                Group = design.df$Group,
                Batch = design.df$Batch,
```

### PCA top 500 variable genes {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

#### Without batch effect correction {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

``` {r PCA}

gene.var <- apply(logCPM, 1, var)

top500 <- names(sort(gene.var, decreasing = TRUE))[1:500]

logCPM.top500 <- logCPM[top500, ]

pca <- prcomp(t(logCPM.top500), scale. = TRUE)

percentVar <- round(100 * (pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)), 1)

pca.df = data.frame(PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
  Group = group,
  Batch = batch,
  Replicate = replicate,
  Batch.Rep = batch.rep)

# Make PCA plot manually
plot = ggplot(pca.df,
       aes(PC1, PC2,
           color = Group,
           shape = Batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sample.annot.color) +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(ncol = 2),
         color = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) + 
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", percentVar[1], "%)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", percentVar[2], "%)")) +
  ggtitle("PCA") +
  plot_theme

embed_plot(plot, width = 8, height = 6)

```

#### With batch effect correction {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

``` {r PCA_batch_effect}

gene.var <- apply(logCPM.corrected, 1, var)
top500 <- order(gene.var, decreasing = TRUE)[1:500]

pca <- prcomp(t(logCPM.corrected[top500, ]), scale. = TRUE)

percentVar <- round(100 * (pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)), 1)

pca.df = data.frame(PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
  Group = group,
  Batch = batch,
  Replicate = replicate,
  Batch.Rep = batch.rep)

# Make PCA plot manually
plot = ggplot(pca.df,
       aes(PC1, PC2,
           color = Group,
           shape = replicate)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sample.annot.color) +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(ncol = 2),
         color = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) + 
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", percentVar[1], "%)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", percentVar[2], "%)")) +
  ggtitle("PCAs with batch effect correction") +
  plot_theme

embed_plot(plot, width = 8, height = 6)

```

## **Co-expressed genes**

```{r coexpressed_genes, fig.width=15, fig.height=8}

# ============================================================
# Define groups 
# ============================================================
groups = unique(group)

# ============================================================
# Build gene sets per group (genes with nonzero count in ≥1 sample)
# ============================================================
gene_sets = setNames(lapply(groups, function(g) {
  # Samples belonging to this group
  samples = design.df$sampleID[design.df$Group == g]
  # Subset normalized count matrix to these samples
  counts = dge$counts[, samples, drop = FALSE]
  # Genes expressed (nonzero count) in at least one sample
  rownames(counts)[rowSums(counts > 0) >= 1]
}), groups)

# All genes observed across all groups
all_genes = unique(unlist(gene_sets))

# Logical presence/absence of each gene in each group
presence_df = data.frame(gene = all_genes,
                         lapply(gene_sets, function(gs) all_genes %in% gs),
                         check.names = FALSE,
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# ============================================================
# 1. Build the combination matrix
# ============================================================
m <- make_comb_mat(presence_df[, groups], mode = "distinct")
m <- m[comb_size(m) > 0]

# Use the matrix's own set order to guarantee alignment downstream
mat_sets <- set_name(m)

# ============================================================
# 2. Named color vector, matched to the matrix's set order
# IMPORTANT: names in sample.annot.color must exactly match mat_sets values
# ============================================================
set_col_vec <- sample.annot.color[mat_sets]

# ============================================================
# 3. Intersection bar colors (top bars)
# Highlight single-group-only combinations using sample.annot.color
# ============================================================
n_groups <- length(mat_sets)

# Build the binary string for each group's "single group only" combination
single_group_combs <- setNames(
  sapply(seq_along(mat_sets), function(i) {
    paste0(ifelse(seq_len(n_groups) == i, "1", "0"), collapse = "")
  }),
  mat_sets
)

# Map: comb string -> color, pulling directly from sample.annot.color
comb_col_vec <- sapply(comb_name(m), function(x) {
  matched_group <- names(single_group_combs)[single_group_combs == x]
  if (length(matched_group) == 1) {
    sample.annot.color[matched_group]
  } else {
    "grey30"
  }
})

# ============================================================
# 4. Build the UpSet plot
# ============================================================
ht <- UpSet(
  m,
  comb_order = order(-comb_size(m)),
  set_order = mat_sets,
  comb_col = comb_col_vec,
  top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
    "Intersection size" = anno_barplot(
      comb_size(m),
      border = FALSE,
      gp = gpar(fill = comb_col_vec),
      height = unit(9, "cm"),
      axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 16), labels_rot = 0)
    ),
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold"),
    annotation_name_side = "left"
  ),
  right_annotation = upset_right_annotation(
    m,
    gp = gpar(fill = set_col_vec),
    width = unit(3, "cm")
  ),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16)
)

# ============================================================
# 5. Draw and add bar count labels
# ============================================================
draw(ht)
od <- column_order(ht)
cs <- comb_size(m)
decorate_annotation("Intersection size", {
  grid.text(
    comma(cs[od]),
    x = seq_along(cs),
    y = unit(cs[od], "native") + unit(2, "pt"),
    default.units = "native",
    just = "bottom",
    rot = 45,
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
  )
})

```
